package_type.value: HEAVY DUTY DIESEL ENGINE OIL ADDITIVE

intended_service.value: An engine oil additive package for formulating super high performance heavy duty diesel engine oils meeting the API CI-4 and ACEA E7 performance specification in API Group II mineral base stocks using Lubrizol’s global performance polymer technologies.

dose_wt_pct.calculation_note: 2020 sheet (DL2-14638.pdf p.1): 'Formulated and approved in combination with Lubrizol® 7077 performance polymer'; 2022 sheet: 'using Lubrizol’s global performance polymer technologies'. Dose not printed.

open_questions: Two Product Data Sheets: DL2-14638.pdf (Published on 20 Jan, 2020) and DL2-15581.pdf (Published on 13 May, 2022). Fields use the 2022 sheet. 2022 adds ACEA E7-22 (2022) and CAT ECF-2; the 2020 sheet lists neither. Cummins CES 20076/77/78 changed from L to A (see conflicts).

SAE grades from the 2022 text: 'Viscosity grade coverage across SAE 20W-50 and 15W-40'. Claim codes: A -> approval, M -> meets, L -> other (code recorded in the scope note per user decision 2026-10-17). No SDS in the archive.
User decision 2026-10-17: 2 claims with Lubrizol code 'L' keep their claim_type; the code and its legend text are recorded in the scope note.
